source_note: Network tablet map layout for C01 (S07, blueprint p.23; reference p.43). Presentation only: column/row cells on the map grid and the localization key of each node's name. The topology, capacities and demands come from grid.json (JSON is the authoritative topology); every grid node must appear here exactly once (test_V07). Rows read top-down from the grid source; the generator branch sits on the bottom row as in the reference.
